# Quirkwell

> Quirkwell makes oddly specific, funny retro t-shirt and gift designs, sold on Redbubble and TeePublic. This site is a gift guide; every product is printed, sold and shipped by Redbubble or TeePublic.

## Gift guides

- [Funny Christmas shirts and gift ideas (2026)](https://quirkwell.com/funny-christmas-shirts.html): The funniest Christmas shirts tell a tiny story at a glance: a T-rex dressed as a Christmas tree, an opossum screaming happily in Christmas lights, or a snowman in sunglasses who is not built for the cold.
- [Gifts for dog lovers, cat lovers and bookworms](https://quirkwell.com/gifts-for-dog-and-cat-lovers.html): For a dog or cat lover, pick a design that matches their pet's personality: a corgi who took over the gift wrapping, or an orange cat asleep on a stack of books.
- [Funny gifts for introverts, overthinkers and coworkers](https://quirkwell.com/gifts-for-introverts-and-overthinkers.html): Good gifts for introverts are funny without asking them to be the center of attention: a social battery at 1%, a sleepy battery in low power mode, or a party checklist that crosses out small talk.
- [Space nerd gifts: retro planet national park shirts](https://quirkwell.com/space-nerd-gifts.html): For space fans, retro national park style badges for Saturn and Mars make a gift that looks like a real souvenir from a place nobody can visit yet.
- [Funny Secret Santa gifts for coworkers](https://quirkwell.com/secret-santa-gifts-for-coworkers.html): A good Secret Santa gift for a coworker is funny, work-safe and small: a mug or sticker with a joke about the end of the year, like Out of Office Until January or Holiday Spirit Still Installing.
- [Cozy gifts for homebodies](https://quirkwell.com/cozy-gifts-for-homebodies.html): The best gifts for homebodies are things they will use on the couch: a soft hoodie or sweatshirt with a cozy joke, or a mug for cocoa, like Blanket Burrito League or My Couch Called, I Answered.
- [Opossum gifts and weird animal shirts](https://quirkwell.com/opossum-and-weird-animal-gifts.html): For an opossum lover, Feral for the Holidays shows a cartoon possum tangled in Christmas lights, screaming happily from a trash can. It comes on shirts, hoodies, stickers and mugs.

## Shop by person

- [Gifts for dog people](https://quirkwell.com/for/dog.html): Gifts for dog people: a corgi who took over the gift wrapping, plus other animal designs for dog moms and dads.
- [Gifts for cat & book people](https://quirkwell.com/for/cat.html): Gifts for cat and book people: an orange cat asleep on a stack of books, cocoa within reach.
- [Gifts for animal lovers](https://quirkwell.com/for/animal.html): Gifts for animal lovers: an opossum in Christmas lights, a goose in a Santa hat, a surfing axolotl, a sloth in a blanket and a T-rex Christmas tree.
- [Gifts for space nerds](https://quirkwell.com/for/space.html): Gifts for space nerds: retro Saturn and Mars national park badges and a UFO beaming up a Christmas tree.
- [Gifts for introverts](https://quirkwell.com/for/introvert.html): Gifts for introverts: a social battery at 1%, low power mode, a party checklist that skips small talk and a bear who is hibernating until spring.
- [Gifts for coworkers](https://quirkwell.com/for/coworker.html): Gifts for coworkers: work-safe jokes about out-of-office replies, stuck progress bars, snack tables and burnout, on mugs, stickers and shirts.
- [Gifts for families](https://quirkwell.com/for/families.html): Shirts for families: matching Christmas designs everyone can wear in the photo, from cookie crews to a grumpy snowman.
- [Gifts for cozy homebodies](https://quirkwell.com/for/cozy.html): Gifts for cozy homebodies: blanket burritos, couches, hot cocoa, croissants and bears hibernating until spring.
